main_text.l: uerit propter nos, vt nimirum subseruiant Ecclesiæ salu-
ti. Breuiùs ita: Credo in Deum creatorem, hoc est, credo
quòd Deus, qui omnia creauit & prouidentia sua gu-
bernat, me & fideles in mundo creauerit, vt celebre-
mus ipsum, atque vt simus Domini creaturarum. Om-
nia vestra sunt: vos autem Christi: Christus vero Dei: quasi
diceret, Omnia sunt creata propter nos, sicut nos
propter Deum.
Ad hanc primam Symboli partem tres Loci com-
munes pertinent, inprimis cognitu necessarij.
1. De Deo.
2. De Creatione.
3. De Dei prouidentia.

page.notes: The first word of the page is a fragment, the start of a sentence from the previous page; the italic "uerit" is partly cut off at the edge, so its first letters are uncertain. The woodcut ornament at left carries a small Q-shaped figure but no text. Small stray marks in the margins are not printed text. "præcipuę." is set on its own line beside the ornament, at the start of the question list, with the heading word "Quæstiones" above it at the edge of the woodcut; it is transcribed as printed.
